name: milton-startup-failures
description: Cloud Run system log lines for a failed probe or a non-zero container exit on milton-app, milton-mcp, milton-auth or milton-admit, e.g. 'Default STARTUP TCP probe failed 1 time consecutively ... The instance was not started.' and 'Container called exit(1).' Read by milton-instance-start and the release gate.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=("milton-app" OR "milton-mcp" OR "milton-auth" OR "milton-admit") AND logName="projects/milton-510506/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Fvarlog%2Fsystem" AND (textPayload:"probe failed" OR (textPayload:"Container called exit(" AND NOT textPayload:"Container called exit(0)."))
